strings.NOV_THENEWORDER_DESC:
Centered in and around the largest city in Siberia, the Federation of Novosibirsk and Altay arose out of the fracturing of the Central Siberian Republic. Under the leadership of the so-called 'Siberian Falcon,' the strongman Alexander Pokryshkin, it forms one of the largest and most powerful splinter states in the region.

One of the primary beneficiaries of Bukharin's Siberian Plan, Novosibirsk itself possesses both an enormous population and an equally impressive industrial base, matched in capacity only by the prodigious agricultural lands of Altay. These dual advantages situate the state well, providing a solid economic base from which to grow.

Not all is well, however. The young Federation faces threatening neighbors, socialist labor agitation, and many decisions regarding the growing influence of elitist groupings within the government - influence strongly opposed by the unofficial 'second man' within the Federation, Vasily Shukshin, the Mayor of Barnaul.

Though none can say for certain whether the Federation will weather the many challenges ahead, all agree that, should it correctly leverage the significant advantages granted by both position and history, it could serve as the nucleus of a powerful - and ever expanding - nation.
strings.NOV_DEF: the Federation of Novosibirsk and Altay
strings.NOV_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
From the ashes of the Central Siberian Republic and Bukharin's industrial brainchild within it, the Siberian Plan, arises the Federation.

When anarchists, socialists, and, eventually, insane medievalists shattered the Republic, and the effete idealists in government proved unable to respond effectively, fighter ace and the Republic's former Marshal of Aviation, Alexander Pokryshkin, the 'Siberian Falcon,' took matters into his own hands. Declaring independence from the central government, he proclaimed himself President of the lands in and around Siberia's industrial capital of Novosibirsk, with Altay, which had also declared independence, joining soon after.
strings.NOV_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
From that city, Pokryshkin has, in the years subsequent, established a strong foundation for his nation-state. Though his regime is fairly authoritarian, and his administration is dominated by the siloviki, politicians originating from the military and security services, it has provided security from the many hostile forces within the volatile region for the enormous population it encomapsses.

This security has enabled rapid economic expansion, which has in turn led to the rise of the national conglomerates, enormous business firms that are increasingly demonstrating their influence over the young state. Many welcome this change, eager for the wealth promised, but others decry the increasingly authoritarian centralization promoted by the firms' siloviki partisans.
strings.NOV_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3:
None decry the silovik nature of the Federation moreso than Vasily Shukshin, the Mayor of Barnaul and the second most important man in the Federation, after only Pokryshkin himself.

Extremely popular with the common people, he promises to be a thorn in the side of any attempt to further restrict freedoms in the pursuit of the industrialist or siloviki agendas. And besides such internal challenges, many external ones exist as well.
strings.NOV_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
And besides such internal challenges, many external ones exist as well.

Novosibirsk is a prize that all within Siberia would, and will, kill to acquire. If the Federation is to survive the coming storm, its leadership must leverage the advantages of location, industry, and population with which it has been blessed - or risk becoming little more than a province within another nation.
strings.NOV_megacorp_1_desc:
The Feniks Corporation is one of the three main economic forces within the Federation, and has long ties with Alexander Pokryshkin. As the principal arms manufacturer and distributor within the Federation, Feniks is both the driving force behind and the beating heart of the Federation's sizable army.

The corporation was founded by prospective siloviki soon after the collapse of the Soviet Union. With their close relationship with Pokryshkin, and their invaluable service as the provider for our armed forces, Feniks Corporation is a natural friend of the government.
strings.NOV_megacorp_2_desc:
Associated with the mayor of Barnaul, the Sibir Corporation was founded by the landowning bourgeoisie following the Soviet Union's collapse. They represent, and hold the principal shares of, agricultural production within the Federation and, indeed, perhaps the entire Central Siberian region. Not only producing agricultural products, but also the agricultural equipment and, surprisingly enough, act as the backbone for much of the Federation's financial institutions, Sibir is certainly the heart of the Federation's civilian industry.

These facts, tied with Sibir's close association with civilian politicians within the silovik-dominated government and tacit support for Vasily Shukshin, make it an incredibly important organ of the Federation's economy.
strings.NOV_megacorp_3_desc:
If Feniks is the Federation's muscle, and Sibir its beating heart, Titan is the Federation's brain. Their motto, simple and precise as the corporation's mission itself, is: “Progress”, and this is what Titan does best.

Geared towards the furthering of the Federation's technological fronts, Titan has long been the frontrunner in the Federation's race towards mechanization and the furthering of all technology, Titan once directly competed with the Modernists in Tomsk.
strings.NOV_megacorp_4_desc:
The Federation does not solely comprise of corporations and the resources that they produce. The Federation, and, by extension, her economy, are fueled by the people - the civilians that live under our administration. These people, from the lowliest rural peasant to the highest administrator within our government, have at least a nominal say in how we run things.

It's important for us to be well aware of the status of our people, how loyal they are to our regime, how popular our administration is, and how influential they are within our borders.

strings.NOV_Silovik_GUI_extra_button_1_tt:
Our primary goal is to successfully takeover all nearby states in Central Siberia and then all of Russia itself, to do this we must complete missions for warlords by paying them in various forms, this is done by pressing on a state in the above map GUI.

In order to speed up this process as much as possible, we should attempt to become ideologically aligned, the closer we are to a warlord ideologically the faster our takeover progress will grow and the more ideologically distant, the slower. We may view our current ideological standpoint by pressing the red button below this one.

To influence our current ideological standpoint, we may take focuses or empower certain Megacorps, the stronger the Megacorp, the more we will lean towards their ideology. We may view our current ideological drift in the button below this one menu and hovering over the £GFX_NOV_GUI_Political_Compass_circle.

Megacorps are not just helpful to drift our ideology, but the more powerful a Megacorp is, the easier it will be to assimilate warlords of that Megacorps ideology. However, should Megacorp Loyalty fall under 50, this will turn into a malus and not a bonus.
To learn about each Megacorp and their ideology click the i under each of their names.

strings.NOV_Disproportionate_Population_desc:
Novosibirsk has always been one of the most developed and densely populated regions across the Urals, as a hub to the Far East and a crucial link on the Trans-Siberian Railway. The city was already one of the biggest in Siberia when the Great Patriotic War broke out, but the conflict itself made it grow even more.

Thousands fled the German occupation, or simply the chaos that unfolded in Russian lands, and they arrived in Novosibirsk, which was soon crowded with civilians. This can be both a blessing and a curse, but it is something we have to live with.
strings.NOV_The_All_Siberian_Army_desc:
The army that is responsible for the protection of the region of Novosibirsk is easily one of the most powerful and prestigious in Central Siberia. When the Siberian Falcon split from the Tomsk government to save himself and his people from the horrors of war, a large fraction of the army of the Central Siberian Republic pledged their loyalty to Pokryshkin, and soon reorganized in the south.

The All-Siberian Army has managed to reform into a force capable of rivalling even the largest neighbors of our warlord state, and the experience many men have from the Great Patriotic War and the Siberian War has proven invaluable.
strings.NOV_Socialist_Agitators_desc: The agitators, anarchists, and criminals of the Narodniks lurk in the shadows of our state, recruiting misguided idealists and hardened criminals in their efforts to subvert our proud Federation; embarking upon sabotage and subversion in a foolish attempt to revive the Union of old. They must be crushed.

They must be crushed.

They must be crushed.
strings.NOV_Barnaul_Grain_desc: With a new contract secured, grain from Altay's fertile fields once more flows into Novosibirsk, greatly easing the food shortages that have been the cause of so much trouble. While concerns about food security remain, for now, we can rest easy and toast to the success and cooperation of the Federation.
strings.NOV_Virgin_Lands_Campaign_desc: The steady resettlement of skilled refugees away from the inner cities and into uncultivated land is proving a major boon thus far. While issues with adequate housing and equipment do remain, the alleviation of overpopulation in the Federation's cities and the increased agricultural production has eased much of our prior concerns regarding food security.
strings.NOV_shock_troops_desc:
Some of the greatest victories of the old Soviet Union were accomplished by shock troops. Men who can strike fast and hit hard, ensuring their opponents will never have time to find their bearing.

Today a new generation of men are being trained to follow in their footsteps. Brandishing automatic weapons and fearless daring, they will proudly carry on the legacy of their predecessors and strike terror into the hearts of our enemies.
strings.NOV_temporary_industry_boost_desc: Recent efforts at improving production and lengthening working hours have greatly improved our industry. While these gains cannot last forever, especially given the discontent of the factory workers, it is enough to grant us a temporary period of increased productivity.
strings.NOV_shoot_rebels_desc: The embers of resistance remain scattered throughout our territories, misguided loyalists, die-hard fanatics, and those who don't seem to know when to quit. Whoever they may be and whatever ideology they follow, monarchists, communists, or anarchists, we will see to it that they remain a threat no longer.
strings.NOV_vestiges_of_revolt_desc: While the band of traitors, subversive, and fools that made up Kostin's farcical workers' revolt may be crushed on the field, their legacy remains. In defiant workers and rebellious holdouts that insist on continuing a fight long since lost. Until these last embers of rebellion are smothered, our industries will struggle to return to a sense of normalcy.
strings.NOV_trading_partner_desc: Thanks to the deft diplomatic ability of our diplomats and the skillful decisions of our government, we found a new trading partner abroad. Isolated for a decade, our businesses and merchants are taking their first steps back into foreign exchanges, and foreign goods, in admittedly small quantities, are reaching our markets once more.
strings.NOV_trading_partner_2_desc: Thanks to the deft diplomatic ability of our diplomats and the skillful decisions of our government, we found a new trading partner abroad. Isolated for a decade, our businesses and merchants are taking their first steps back into foreign exchanges, and foreign goods, in admittedly small quantities, are reaching our markets once more.
strings.NOV_spreading_the_sibplan_idea_desc: It was Bukharin's Union before us that brought the spectacles of modern industrial life to the desolate tundras of Central Siberia; however, the Far East was largely untouched by the Siberian Plan and left devoid of a substantial industrial base. The Far East's derelict state can no longer be tolerated, as such, we will transform its vast, barren landscape into a sea of life, wealth industry through both the establishment of state ventures in the region and cooperation with local corporations.
strings.NOV_our_eastern_bastion_idea_desc: With our position in Siberia secure, funding and resources are once more being poured into our naval facilities in Magadan. Expanded docks and newly dredged harbors will form the nucleus of our first efforts to rebuild our naval power. After all, the longest journey begins with a single step.
strings.NOV_rnd_modifier_desc: In order to synthesize the various research efforts within Novosibirsk, the Central Deisgn Bureau has been established. Tasked with overseeing, designing, and organzing all scientific endeavors, the Central Design Bureau acts as a focal point, allowing efficient and coordinated work between different groups, ensuring new and advanced technologies are developed and implemented quickly.
strings.NOV_victorious_federation_desc: Our enemies lie defeated beneath the boots of the All-Siberian Army. From the Mongol steppe to the frigid reaches of Norilsk, the Federation stands above all. A bright future lies ahead, but the task of winning the peace, it seems, will be no less strenuous than winning the war.
strings.NOV_sovereign_security_act_desc: With the passage of the Sovereign Security Act, our internal security forces have recorded both an increase in funding and a decrease in terror. Slowly, steadily, our brave men in uniform are rooting out the subversives and traitors who would dare threaten to betray our great Federation.

strings.NOV_narodnik_investigation_category_desc:
It appears the Narodnik, socialist agitators including anarchists and communists, have grown bolder in their attacks. These terrorists must be dealt with by force as soon as possible, as we risk an uprising in the case of war.

Our security services must investigate any lead possible, disrupt their operations, and contain their threat before they can cause any massive damage. Many of their hideouts have already been located, and operations have been planned. The Federation is no home to terrorist scum!
--------------
INVESTIGATION PROGRESS: {NOV_investigation_progress}%
strings.NOV_funnel_resources_to_investigation_de: The excision of the Narodnik menace will not be an easy one. Our security forces will be stretched thin dealing with them, not to mention having to handle other threats separate from these socialist terrorists. We can divert extra resources from other security departments to the Narodnik investigation in order to improve our operation capabilities.
strings.NOV_infiltrate_narodnik_cells_desc: The socialist terrorists menacing our statelet are of unknown number, and well concealed. Our lack of information about their activities has allowed them to continually get the better of us. They are guarded enough that the only way to discover their intentions from the inside. Sending SB agents disguised as impressionable citizens to join their ranks will give us valuable intelligence and allow us to draw them into our clutches, without the Narodniks suspecting a thing.
strings.NOV_investigate_factories_in_novosibirsk: Novosibirsk's working classes are generally discontented about their conditions and thus easy targets for the terrorists' recruiters, who preach the virtues of wealth redistribution. As a result, rumors have spread that the Narodniks have already infiltrated the city's many factories, spreading their propaganda on the shop floor and inducting workers into their ranks. We cannot allow the engines of our economic progress to become our greatest security threat.
strings.NOV_increase_patrols_in_altay_desc: The Altay region is a geographer's dream, filled with tall mountains and great forests. This quality also makes it a counterinsurgency nightmare. Narodniks evading justice have taken refuge throughout the region, hiding out and even stashing weapons in the rugged terrain. Allowing the terrorists to grow roots into our territory would be a grave mistake, necessitating the allocation of more resources to security forces in the area.
strings.NOV_conduct_an_internal_investigation_de: The Narodniks have seemingly developed a presence almost everywhere in Novosibirsk, even within their enemies' ranks. It was not long ago that socialism was Russia's prevailing ideology, after all, and there are those among the officer class that wish they were leading a Red Army instead of our own. Security organs infiltrated by the terrorist threat will naturally be ineffective at fighting it, and we need to prove that no one, not even an officer, is above the law.
strings.NOV_the_final_raid_desc: Our investigations into the Narodnik movement have been numerous and thorough, and they have yielded a great deal of very valuable information. We now have good intelligence regarding the location of their main hideout, where their elusive leadership spins a web of terror and destruction throughout our territory. Decapitating the movement by targeting the masterminds in a decisive police raid will splinter it, seriously reducing the threat posed to our institutions.
strings.NOV_siberian_expansion_category_desc: With our domestic situation under control for the time being it is time for us to look outward. We are surrounded by threats to our sovereignty and our further control of Central Siberia. Now, we must decide where and how to strike. Whether we expand by force or by diplomacy, it will also be crucial that we prepare as best we can for the inevitable problem of integration.
strings.NOV_operation_homecoming_desc: Before us in Tomsk lies the remnants of the great beast from which our state formed, the {tom_getname}. While they may have meant well, their experiment became a failure long ago, and all that remains is for someone to show them just how ineffectual it has become. That someone will be us. Our forces await eagerly the order to invade, ready to tear apart the rotten institutions piece by piece, and liberate the territory still held by the salons and their loyalists.
strings.NOV_operation_homecoming_disband_the_sal: The Salons of Tomsk, while made up of undoubtedly great intellectuals, have long since outlived their usefulness. Even now, under our occupation, they debate endlessly and pointlessly about the correct course of action, giving faint hope to those who continue to believe in the failed experiment of the Central Siberian Republic even now. The Salons must be finally disbanded before this hope becomes determination, or even rebelliousness.
strings.NOV_operation_homecoming_absorb_their_de: Not all of the component parts of the government in Tomsk were useless. The Design Bureau, in particular, was a shining star in a sea of ineffectual governance, continuing to innovate even as the Republic crumbled. As we continue to integrate the lands the remnant Central Siberian Republic held, it would be wise to integrate their scientists into the teams employed by Titan, in order to bolster our own technological prowess.
strings.NOV_operation_kingbreaker_desc: The farcical neo-Rurikid regime to our west has long been a thorn in our side, and their mad king's nonsense has gone on for long enough. Operation: Kingbreaker is, as the name implies, aimed at crushing the {kem_getname} once and for all to bring the Kuznetsk Basin under our control.
strings.NOV_operation_kingbreaker_the_coal_of_ke: The mineral-rich Kuznetsk Basin now lies under our control, and now we have to decide what to do with it. The previous regime was woefully unable to exploit it properly, and now it falls to us to expand the coal mining infrastructure here.
strings.NOV_operation_kingbreaker_fate_of_the_so: Rurik's “kingdom” now lies shattered into a million pieces thanks to our victory, but the question remains of what to do with his ministers. The so-called “Zemsky Sobor” was the King's idea of a parliament, and the many politicians who were part of it await their fate. What shall be done with them?
strings.NOV_operation_raskol_desc:
All preparations for the invasion of {alt_getname} are complete. Ruled jointly by Old Believers and the Altay people, the unitary and religious nature of their state stands in contrast to our Federation.

Although an entirely unambitious government, unlike most others in the region, they nevertheless stand in the way of the unification of Central Siberia, and as such must be defeated completely by our forces and brought into the fold.
strings.NOV_operation_raskol_institute_secular_a: The privileges of the Old Believers in Oyrotia have gone on for far too long. Allowed governmental authority on a religious basis due to the dualistic nature of the Oyrotian state, their ability to rule over the people in the name of God is unreasonable and tyrannical. We must put a stop to it now that we control the territory.
strings.NOV_operation_empty_words_desc: Operation: Empty Words is aimed at striking hard at the military regime in the {krs_getname}, led by one General Andreev. Andreev has supposedly made a great deal of idealistic promises to his people, but it's obvious that these are not but meaningless platitudes. Our offensive will bring this aspiring despot down, and in the process secure a critical rail hub.
strings.NOV_operation_empty_words_seize_the_abak: Now that the region of Krasnoyarsk lies under our control, the fruits of this critical lynchpin of Central Siberia now lay open to us. One of them is the military arsenal at Abakan, which contains a treasure trove of valuable arms and munitions. We must seize this facility and get it back up and running again.
strings.NOV_operation_empty_words_welcome_the_wi: Andreev might have been defeated, but his allies may just be willing to aid our cause. We will reach out to some of his administrators and commanders and try to strike some kind of deal with them. Should they agree, it would make integration of the region all the more simple.
strings.NOV_operation_tachanka_desc: Operation: Tachanka has been a long time coming. The so-called {sba_getname} was one of the main factors in the collapse of the Central Siberian Republic, and now it falls to us to put their foolish rebellion down. Their forces are inherently disorganized thanks to their misguided anarchist ideals, and cannot hope to stand up to our might.
strings.NOV_operation_tachanka_enforce_order_upo: The Siberian Black Army may lie defeated at our hands, but their misguided ideals have been deeply embedded into the lands now under our control. This cannot stand. We shall purge the taint of anarchism from these lands and crush any who refuse to cooperate.
strings.NOV_operation_tachanka_disband_the_worke: The lands west of the former Black Army have organized themselves into many “workers' councils.” These misguided “councils” have done little but hinder the economic development of their lands, and shall henceforth be disbanded, allowing our companies a free hand in developing the territories west of the Yenisei.
strings.NOV_operation_sole_survivor_desc: To the south are the last remnants of the Red Army here in Central Siberia. Alexander Vasilevsky has demonstrated an admirable level of persistence in his duties leading the {prc_getname}, but sadly, his time is up. Operation: Sole Survivor is among the more ambitious of our war plans, as it will take our forces through some rather hard terrain. Vasilevsky's forces are well-trained and prepared, so caution must be taken.
strings.NOV_operation_sole_survivor_the_red_army: The Red Army in Tuva has over two decades of fighting experience under its belt, and many of its members have expressed interest in continuing their service in our army. Integrating these veterans will provide invaluable experience to our own armed forces.
strings.NOV_operation_sole_propose_the_tuvan_fed: Vasily Shukshin, Mayor of Barnaul, has proposed the creation of a “Tuvan Federal Republic” to better integrate the region into our Federation. Shukshin claims that granting autonomy to the Tuvan people would make them more loyal to our government, if at the cost of limiting our influence in the area. The decision, however, lies in our hands.
strings.NOV_project_bichevatel_desc: The fighter is the workhorse of any modern air force, well suited for defending airspace, attacking enemy formations, and protecting bombers over enemy territory. It is vital that we have a fighter capable of competing with anything the Germans, Japanese, or Americans can field. A new design, dubbed the MiG-23, may be just what we are looking for. Sporting variable wing geometry and an experimental radar system, it will be one of the most advanced aircraft in the world.
strings.NOV_project_2_desc: There is more to controlling the skies than having the best planes. Land-based aircraft are vital to defending our cities and production centers from air raids, and Russia's aerial defenses are woefully inadequate to defend against a modern bombing fleet. The solution lies in developing a system of surface-to-air guided missiles similar to those of our rivals around the globe. A prototype missile, the S-25, is a strong candidate to lead the next generation of Russian anti-aircraft weapons.
strings.NOV_project_3_desc: Defending our own skies is necessary, but if we truly want to contest the air, we must be able to strike at the enemy directly, hitting them where it hurts most. Our current fleet of bombers would be chewed to pieces if they ever tried to raid Germania or Tokyo, but we cannot concede the opportunities presented by strategic bombing of the enemy homeland. A new, supersonic long-range bomber is needed. One design we have received, the M-50, promises to deliver exactly that.
strings.NOV_project_4_desc: When it comes to interceptor aircraft, the most important factor is unquestionably speed. If the interceptor is fast enough, it can blow past any escort aircraft and run-down cumbersome bombers before they get close to their target. We have received a design for a new interceptor, the MiG-25, that if successful would be one of the fastest aircraft on the planet. A defensive squadron of these planes would make even the Luftwaffe think twice before crossing Russia's borders.
strings.NOV_project_5_desc: The attack helicopter has revolutionized land warfare, allowing troops to receive fire support faster than ground-attack planes could manage and making rapid aerial interruptions of enemy movements far easier. Russia has lagged far behind in the area of helicopter development, but the new Mi-24 Gunship promises to fix that. Heavily armored and equipped with both machine guns and air-to-land missiles, this helicopter will spell doom for any enemy that hears it approaching.
strings.NOV_project_fuck_pindosi_desc: Airmobile infantry are the next generation of the fighting man, faster and more maneuverable than any land-based infantry unit could be. However, the unique nature of their transportation and deployment mean that standard infantry equipment is poorly situated for their needs. A new, more compact assault rifle in the early phases of development dubbed the TKB-011 may be the solution. The 011 could be well suited for the hectic, close quarters fighting our airmobile units often find themselves in.
strings.NOV_project_abakan_tt: We will begin researching a new type of assault rifle.
strings.NOV_The_Election_category_desc: As a result of growing tensions amongst the leadership of the Federation, the Co-Rulers have decided to put an end to these tensions by putting the decision up to an election. Each of the candidates will jockey for support from the various groups in the Federation, and will undoubtedly work to undermine each other.
strings.NOV_election_bar_support_tt:
Current support for Alexander Pokryshkin is [?NOV_pokryshkin_support|Y]
Current support for Vasily Shukshin is [?NOV_shukshin_support|Y]
strings.NOV_meet_with_industrialists_desc: Outside of the government, nobody in the country has more sway than the captains of industry. They have deep pockets and large networks of influence that allow them to change thousands of minds through advertisement campaigns and political donations. A private summit with the industrialists, where Pokryshkin promises them concessions in exchange for campaign support, would go a long way in convincing the elite that another presidential term is in their favor.
strings.NOV_encourage_infighting_among_oppositio: Pokryshkin's opponents are significantly less of a united front than the government, a fact that is almost exclusively to our advantage. If we can convince some of the myriad factions involved in the Shukshin campaign to cause discontent within his ranks, it will make the opposition unable to effectively campaign against us. The more confusion, the better, and we may even be able to shatter the opposition's unity entirely.
strings.NOV_hold_military_parade_desc: The easiest fallback for a flagging political campaign is stirring up feelings of nationalism among the people. Grand demonstrations of military strength remind potential voters that Pokryshkin has made the country strong, and that he is the only one who can protect them from their myriad enemies. A politicized parade might even suppress the opposition if it can convince them that the army won't tolerate their victory. All in all, this would practically be a pro-government rally with tanks.
strings.NOV_utilize_the_sb_desc: Holding a competitive election demonstrates to the public the government's resolve to behave honorably towards the opposition. Behind closed doors, we can happily discard this pretense. Using the security services against the Shukshin campaign may not be fair, but it could be an incredibly effective way to hamper it. Digging (or even inventing) dirt on Shukshin and exposing it in state media would be a powerful way to turn voters against him.
strings.NOV_promote_national_unity_desc: To win the election, we need to send a message. A message of national unity. Propaganda must be created highlighting the positive sides of our administration, unity, and all the qualities we desire in our nation. Posters shall line every wall of every building, and radio ads will play on every radio station on every frequency. We must not let factionalism and ideology tear our nation apart. Our nation must be united behind its benevolent government, for the sake of the Motherland.
strings.NOV_meet_with_democratic_activists_desc: If Shuksin's campaign is supposed to succeed, the opposition to the siloviki must stand united. Pokryshkin is likely already exploiting the ideological differences among our allies, so we must act quick. Shuksin shall organize numerous meetings with democratic advocates, calling for cohesion and a united front. If we wish to truly make our nation a democracy, we must not let our last chance be torn to shreds.
strings.NOV_denounce_corruption_desc: Ultimately, our goal in this election will be to upend the system that has crushed our fair country for so long. The state sponsored oppression, the greed, the violence, the corruption. We must lay all of this bare for the people to see and take a stand against it in the name of democracy, freedom, and the true values that we formed this country to represent. We will denounce the siloviks for what they truly are: corrupt oppressors.
strings.NOV_appeal_to_the_common_people_desc: Our cause is one for the masses, not the corrupt siloviks in their ivory towers. To the common Russian, we offer what we have to give: reforms, freedom, and self-determination. We promise as much as we can give in our power to make their lives better. More importantly, however, we will be contrasting this to what the siloviks have given the common Russian for the last several years: stagnancy, oppression and corruption.
strings.NOV_talk_to_sympathetic_officers_desc: This country we now live in, once a mere warlord state, was built not just by statesmen but by soldiers and their lionhearted leaders. Thus, officers of the military are deeply respected and although many are apolitical, there are a good few who are deeply interested in the workings of our nation. Among them, there should be those sympathetic to our cause, to freeing our country from the shackles of the siloviks. We should approach them and make sure they stay on our side, and see about using their ample resources.
strings.NOV_hold_speech_in_barnaul_desc: Barnaul is the heart of our democratic movement, where it all began. We will hold a rally there, for all Russians to see, and Shukshin will make his case to the people. He will do this through an impassioned speech before crowds of his supporters and the radios of folks across the country. Hopefully, the message of freedom will ring true in the hearts of those who open their ears to it.
strings.NOV_election_results_tt: The victor in the elections will be determined!
strings.NOV_election_action_in_progress: A political action is in progress
strings.NOV_raise_pokryshkin_support_low_tt: This will increase the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a small amount.
strings.NOV_raise_pokryshkin_support_mid_tt: This will increase the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a moderate amount.
strings.NOV_raise_pokryshkin_support_high_tt: This will increase the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a large amount.
strings.NOV_lower_pokryshkin_support_low_tt: This will decrease the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a small amount.
strings.NOV_lower_pokryshkin_support_mid_tt: This will decrease the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a moderate amount.
strings.NOV_lower_pokryshkin_support_high_tt: This will decrease the support for Alexander Pokryshkin by a large amount.
strings.NOV_raise_shukshin_support_low_tt: This will increase the support for Vasily Shukshin by a small amount.
strings.NOV_raise_shukshin_support_mid_tt: This will increase the support for Vasily Shukshin by a moderate amount.
strings.NOV_raise_shukshin_support_high_tt: This will increase the support for Vasily Shukshin by a large amount.
strings.NOV_lower_shukshin_support_low_tt: This will decrease the support for Vasily Shukshin by a small amount.
strings.NOV_lower_shukshin_support_mid_tt: This will decrease the support for Vasily Shukshin by a moderate amount.
strings.NOV_lower_shukshin_support_high_tt: This will decrease the support for Vasily Shukshin by a large amount.
strings.NOV_land_of_the_strong_desc:
The Federation of Novosibirsk and Altay is the largest splinter state that separated from the Central Siberian Republic, even rivaling its remnant to the north in terms of power and military might. Its President, the aviator Alexander Pokryshkin who is commonly known as the Falcon, runs the state in an increasingly authoritarian manner.

Novosibirsk has also been overwhelmed by the wave of refugees that came from the evacuation eastward, which has caused a multitude of issues.

The Falcon and his government will have to find solutions to the problems that have started to torment its people if he is to unite the region.
strings.NOV_the_internal_situation_desc:
The internal situation within the Federation has continued to deteriorate in recent months. Leftist revolutionaries have tried to undermine the stability of the state, their methods of doing so have become incredibly heinous.

The government will have to make difficult decisions on the freedoms of the people in order to take a harsh stance on such dangerous dissent.

Once the internal situation has been dealt with, we must hope that the regime will be strengthened enough to turn our attention on to our enemies that threaten the region.
strings.NOV_the_security_question_desc:
Law enforcement has steadily become more and more difficult as tensions between the government and political agitators have led to terrorist attacks, which are suspected to have been orchestrated by rebellious socialists.

These cowardly actions have caused a great deal of domestic instability, which cannot be allowed to continue. Security will have to be improved in order to combat the threat that the terrorists pose to our future.

The state will have to make these changes to maintain law and order.
strings.NOV_expand_the_security_agencies_desc:
Due to the recent increase in Narodnik terrorist activity in major cities, President Pokryshkin has signed an executive order expanding the powers of the Sluzhba Bezopasnosti, or SB. As the main federal security agency in Novosibirsk and Barnaul, the SB has kept the Federation safe from socialist and anarchist agitation almost since its foundation.

Now with these new powers, the SB should be able to act with impunity against socialist terrorists, without intervention from local or federal governments. The Narodniks must be ended as soon as possible lest they begin to cause chaos, and the SB is the only thing that will get the job done right.
strings.NOV_investigate_the_narodniks_desc:
One of the largest known terrorist groups that have been carrying out attacks against the people of Novosibirsk is called “Nardoniks”. The group is composed of socialist agitators who are attempting to topple the Falcon's regime. They have perpetuated the violence within our borders for too long, they will have to be dealt with directly.

First, we will have to investigate the movements of the group to begin to understand how it functions, as well as who is involved.

But shortly after that we will have to start clamping down on their atrocious crimes.
strings.NOV_meet_with_shukshin_desc:
The President of the Federation, Alexander Pokryshkin, is to meet with the mayor of Barnaul, for there has become a need to discuss the issues that are key to the lives of the people of Barnaul and the future strength of the Federation as a whole.

Barnaul is rich in agriculture, food that is desperately needed in the overpopulated cities throughout the Federation. An agreement must be made between the two parties, otherwise both their prospects will be bleaker.

We must hope that Pokryshkin finds a beneficial settlement with the mayor, for the betterment of both their people.
strings.NOV_a_bountiful_relationship_desc:
A conclusion on the future relationship of Barnaul and Novosibirsk is about to be reached between President Pokryshkin and Mayor Vasily Shukshin. He will learn of the benefits of living under the authority of Pokryshkin, Shukshin will also be made aware of the need to pay for such a vital service.

Shukshin will have to listen to our demands, for the sake of Barnaul's security he will offer his farmlands. The fertile fields of Barnaul will be used to the betterment of the entire population of the Federation, not just the people who live under the mayor.

He will learn that he must cooperate with our interests.
strings.NOV_tighten_control_desc:
Stability has to be increased within the Federation, we can not risk any form of dissent in case it evolves into a more violent form of resistance. We can not allow violence to occur, we owe the people peace within the borders that they live, they surely understand this. The government has to tighten its control over the state, after all they are aware of the dangerous alternatives to stronger authority.

Because of this reason, they must be allowed to strengthen their grip, they know what is and is not good for the Federation and they will make sure everyone is safer.
strings.NOV_the_soldiers_soviet_desc:
In contrast to its neighbors in the region, the Federation of Novosibirsk and Altay is a Silovik State: a polity where the political processes are under the guiding hand of the former and sometimes current military personnel. As a result, many civilian bureaucrats wishing to participate in traditional party politics find themselves barred from running for office, and the compliance demanded by the Siloviks of their non-military counterparts can often be too much.

And all of this - they are by design. Russia has moved past the need for a Soviet Union, for a Central Siberian Republic, or for the monstrous and brutal ideologies that seek to dominate Russian political thought. The pedestrians may chant, “fucking Siloviki, man,” at every injury, but they are not aware of the bastion that protects them from the harm of ideological thought.
strings.NOV_the_champions_of_industry_desc:
One hallmark that distinguishes the Federation of Novosibirsk and Altay from the likes of the mystical king in Kemerovo, the Black Army in Kansk, and the Republic in Tomsk is the presence of corporations that dominate the daily life of its citizens. Three of the most dominant are the Feniks, Sibir, and Titan, each specializing in the different sectors of the economy. The Feniks, the most aggressively pro-Silovik of them all, are manufacturers of military equipment. The Sibir, who are vaguely aligned with Mayor Shukshin of Barnaul, is the primary source of our agricultural tools as well as financial experts. Lastly, there are the Titans, the leading pioneers and technocrats within Novosibirsk's society.

When the time comes, President Pokryshkin will have to decide where his allegiances lie. Perhaps, down the road, he may even choose the people instead. All is possible, in the city where the sun sets.
strings.NOV_the_rising_phoenix_desc:
There is a long history between President Pokryshkin and the Feniks Corporation. The state relies on the latter to provide military equipment for defense against its neighbors, and the former provides them with political clout to protect their labor practices... or lack thereof. Founded by prospective Siloviks after the fall of the Central Siberian Republic, it has enjoyed close relations with the Federation in general, and the office of the Presidency in particular. They are certainly a reliable partner, steadfast in their dedication towards defending the Federation from external, material threats.

Who are we to say no? The Sibir may offer increased agricultural production and economic growth, but these factors will not defend Novosibirsk from all who choose to plunder its wealth. No - to match its defense in the political realm against extremism, the state needs armaments to fight it in the day-to-day life as well. When the Republic calls, the Feniks shall answer.
strings.NOV_the_siberian_bear_desc:
The Sibir Corporation has a bit of an odd history regarding its founding. In the public's image, it is associated with the Mayor of Barnaul, Vasily Shukshin, one of the rare civilian politicians that had found success within Novosibirsk's Silovik-dominated political system. Founded by the landowning bourgeoisie that had come into existence after the fall of the Central Siberian Republic, they produce agricultural equipment and produce, as well as financial institutions that have helped many in Novosibirsk escape the poverty of the working class.

Their question is both political and economic: the Feniks has been in a business relationship with the Federation since their founding, and signing contracts with Sibir is a risk. However, Russia will not be at war forever, and military equipment will not help us against the grip of poverty. If the President wishes to quell extremist thought within his Federation, then the best antidote may be economic prosperity.
strings.NOV_glory_to_the_pioneers_desc:
Progress is the sole keyword of the Titan Corporation. Specializing in delivering technological solutions to mundane problems, they have become the forefront in Central Siberian science, competing directly with the Modernists in Tomsk. Considering that they were cut from the same cloth, it is no wonder that they are so successful. However, unlike the idealist Modernists, the scientists, technocrats, and investors of the Titan Corporation do not care much about their contribution to universal science. They are a scientific organization within a free market: therefore they must compete. Sadly, this apathy extends to their labor practices, with long hours and hard work expected of the average employee.

The Federation will invite the wrath of the people should it choose to side with the Titan. However, we all are not so privileged to pay the price of progress.
strings.NOV_overtures_to_the_people_desc:
The people of the Federation are restless. They look upon the power of the Junta and the corporations with worry and apprehension. In order to placate the people, we should loosen the reigns ever so slightly. This is not to say we will let them have free reign, but a lighter touch is perhaps the smarter way forward.

First, we should lessen the restrictions on the press. Allowing a freer press will give the people a way to see the benefits of our rule. Of course, the proper content restrictions will still apply, after all, it would be foolish to allow the slander of the Federation.

Second, we will need to give the unions a slightly larger degree of autonomy. Giving the workers a (state-sponsored) union to air their grievances too will allow us to better keep them under wraps. These unions will, of course, have only so much power and will ultimately answer to the government.

Finally, there must be a general de-escalation of repression against the middle-class in particular. While they will still need to be restricted, a lessening of restrictions will grant us better support amongst them, and will therefore allow us to better control the working class.
strings.NOV_always_an_even_trade_desc:
The Federation is, like many other polities, a collectivity arranged upon the interests of many. Classes, corporations, unions, and the government - these all vie for supremacy within a system that allows their forces to coalesce and compromise. As such, the Federation's political system is always a zero-sum game. A move made somewhere can never be reverted. It is a harsh system, but politics have been pitiless and cruel since the beginning of time.

As such, the President's decisions will matter in a lot of ways - but we cannot foretell what the future holds for the Federation. All he must do is to live with the consequences of his actions, should they arise. Novosibirsk and Altay gaze at the future, and a cautious optimism rises in the heart of its citizens. Someday, what Bukharin had built as the center of Siberia shall be the beating heart of a new Russian political system.
strings.NOV_veterans_of_the_siberian_war_desc:
One of the greatest advantages Novosibirsk has over its regional opponents is our comparatively large and experienced army. An army whose soldiers cut their teeth on the front lines of the Siberian War, before our eventual secession from the Republic that has since shrunk back into Tomsk. By studying our past battles and examining our successes and failures, we can improve the effectiveness of our forces.

The experience of our troops will likely give us a great advantage in future conflict, as the armies of our neighbors remain undisciplined and under equipped.
strings.NOV_our_own_shock_troops_desc:
Our generals have devised a plan to expand the scope of our armed force, by investing in special training designed to improve our unit's ability to strike fast and effectively through opposing armies. These soldiers will be skilled in breaking through enemy front lines, limiting the amount of damage future wars will have on our army and citizenry.

Furthermore, deployment of these elite troops will certainly continue to heighten our military edge over the rest of the region and deter any warlord or state foolish enough to plan an invasion against us.
strings.NOV_the_skies_are_ours_desc:
An air force is a rare asset to any force in Central Siberia, or indeed the rest of Russia, but Novosibirsk was fortunate enough to inherit the majority of the Central Siberian Republic's air force, along with many of its officers who now make up our government. Included among the officers who set up the new government is President Pokryshkin, the “Siberian Falcon” himself.

Improvement of the existing infrastructure and air bases, as well as development of new technology for our air force has proven a popular idea amongst these ministers who plan to push forward these proposals. The skies of Central Siberia will remain ours to control.
strings.NOV_mechanized_infantry_desc:
As one of the few states of Russia that still maintains a capable and decently sized industry, we should use it to our advantage and expand our mechanized forces. Our Federation's armed forces will gain a great technological advantage, as other states remain comparatively unarmored.

The increased maneuverability will also help to capitalize on any breakthrough we make, which would make us become an unstoppable military force.
strings.NOV_the_fruits_of_the_siberian_plan: The Fruits of the Siberian Plan
strings.NOV_the_fruits_of_the_siberian_plan_desc:
Novosibirsk was one of the places that benefitted the most from Bukharin's Siberian Plan. Since those times, our industry has seen a large step up in its output. The Federation's economy is still developing because of it, with new factories continuing to open, advancements being made in construction technology and the expansion of infrastructure across the state.

All of these factors have greatly improved our industrial efficiency, allowing us to produce a greater volume of equipment for our military, bringing us another step closer to national reunification.
strings.NOV_the_virgin_lands_campaign_desc:
A new plan has emerged from our government to help alleviate the large amount of stress that has been put on our agricultural output. Put simply, as our population has inflated, our production of grain has not. This issue is rapidly becoming the greatest crisis in Novosibirsk, besides the enduring pandemic.

Fortunately, the plan our government has come up with deals with both the food shortage and the disproportionate population, by resettling refugees in farmsteads where the land is yet to be cultivated. Ultimately, this will start improving agricultural output and the lives of the refugees.
strings.NOV_crack_down_on_the_strikes_desc:
Workers have started to resort to direct action. Factories lay dormant and hollow throughout every city; production has slowed to a sluggish pace. We can only assume that the workers have become uppity because of their “unfair” conditions, but we cannot concede, or they will soon be asking for the earth. Our government has determined to crush these strikes and put the working classes back to work.

The crackdowns will escalate tension with our workers, but a few disgruntled factory labourers being put back to work would be a much more preferable outcome than constant deadlock and economic inefficiency.
strings.NOV_ramp_up_arms_production_desc:
The army will need more arms if it is to continue to expand large enough to absolutely dominate the region and bring the rest of the lands of Central Siberia into the Federation, through threats or force. An increase in production quotas for all armaments is to be ordered by the government to help with the expansion of the armed forces.

Many of the recent actions of the government have upset the workers, this is unlikely to improve the situation. And if the tensions persist, grave consequences will face the Federation in the future.
strings.NOV_the_beating_heart_of_siberia_desc:
Novosibirsk thrives, the streets are brimming with people, factories are chocked full of workers and any crime that remains is practically unnoticeable. The city is so rich that even the few beggars that remain appear fed and decently clothed. Such spectacles are a stark contrast to the anarchy of the east and destruction to our west.

It appears that our decisions have turned out better than we could have ever expected, not that there was ever any doubt of their success. Developments in agriculture, industry and even our stability have made Novosibirsk the most desirable city throughout Siberia, despite the cost of some freedoms.
strings.NOV_our_destiny_made_manifest_desc:
Novosibirsk has spent the last arduous months fighting its internal issues: drugs, crime and socialist agitators, but these problems have been solved and our position has become strengthened. Instead of looking in, it is time to look out from our current borders. Generals have already been ordered to start drawing up their war plans, in preparation for the battles that they are to fight. With the fight of the Federation's army under their command, our conquest of Central Siberia is all but assured.

For the Falcon's wings are no longer clipped and it is time for the Federation to take flight.
strings.NOV_spring_rasputitsa_desc:
As winter snows give way to springs thaws, and as nature comes back to life in the many forests and fields of Central Siberia, so too have the armies. Terrain deemed unusable in winter months, are now fully accessible in spring. Roads, once impervious to the flow of men or machines, are finding themselves clogged with the movement of soldiers and vehicles.

As tensions rise, and armies mobilize, it is clear that war is on the horizon, and if we are to emerge victorious in the struggles ahead, we cannot afford to rest on our laurels.
strings.NOV_encourage_forward_thinking_desc:
Clouds gather on the horizon, and if the Federation is to emerge victorious from the wars sure to come, we must not only ensure that our people possess faith in and a desire for our eventual victory, but also that they work to advance it.

To that end, we will work to properly educate them about the future that could be, the Russia that could be, if they will only work for it. Expected increases in civil participation and work ethic cannot but support our goals, economic and otherwise, and should therefore be pursued.
strings.NOV_a_rural_urban_base_desc:
If we are to remain stable, strong, and united for the challenges we face, both now and in the future, we must ensure that our people feel a sense of true community. Currently, within the Federation there is an acknowledged split in experience and outlook between our rural communities and our industrialized urban centres. We must correct this.

A campaign of education with a specific focus on appealing to the shared experiences of both communities will be commissioned. In doing so, we will ensure that we speak to members of both, show them the experiences of the other, and unite them all behind the state for the tribulations ahead.
strings.NOV_the_patriots_federation_desc:
Our efforts to convince the people of the need to support the state continue. It has been proposed that we communicate to the people the exceptional nature both of Russia and of the Federation, and in so doing encouraging newfound patriotism within them for the unifications ahead.

In addition, by focusing on those particular exceptional properties of our state, such as our independent and optimistic spirit, our provision of voting rights to those who give honorable service, and more, we can shape this patriotism into its most valuable form.
strings.NOV_hybridize_the_state_apparatus_desc:
A decision must be made on the construction of our organs of state, and it has been proposed that we act to integrate our military and civilian apparatus, consolidating functions, influence, staff, leadership, and more into new, hybridized forms. This is clearly the superior choice.

Both sectors are each inextricably linked into and directly impact our national security situation, and by remaining separate present many vulnerabilities for our enemies to exploit. Joining them together will reduce the number of these opportunities, and better secure the state.
strings.NOV_look_to_our_roots_desc:
A decision must be made on the construction of our organs of state, and it has been proposed that we focus on strengthening our institutions along the lines of foundational practices through reinforcing federalist principles within them. This is clearly the optimal choice.

The Federation was established along strong roots of controlled democracy and federalist practices, and we cannot permit the compromise of these for any reason, as such threatens the overall identity of the state. Despite the concerns of some, our state will remain secure - by remaining true.
strings.NOV_entice_the_giants_desc:
The captains of industry within the corporate giants are a critical part of our country's development and no effort can be spared in pleasing them. It was with their support that we have turned the Federation into a state truly worthy of existence, and it is with their support that we will unite all of Russia under that state.

To entice them into supporting us further, we will offer them some benefits to reward them for their aid up until now, such as appointment to economic positions in our government and making our taxes on them even more lenient than they already are. While this will blur the line between corporation and state further, that is a necessary sacrifice for leading Russia into greatness.
strings.NOV_sunrise_democracy_sunset_dictatorshi:
When the dawn comes upon the soil of the Federation, the apparatus of state welcomes its light unto the foyers and antechambers of democracy. Here, at the start of each day, the magistrates and bureaucrats serve the people. Counting local votes, adjusting economic policies, and directing the flow of goods - all in the name of ensuring that the people are well-cared-for. At midday, when the civil servants go to lunch, the President and his Siloviks tour the country, seeking support. However, like the Tsars, Emperors, General Secretaries, and Premiers before him, his power was never in question. When night falls and the earth grows dark, the Security Service prowl the streets of the city, seeking to root out those who oppose the righteous dictatorship.

Thus is the unspoken motto of the Federation: democracy at sunrise, a monarchy at midday, and a dictatorship at the end of the day. Quiet falls over the fields of Siberia, and no whispers of deceit could be heard: not from communists or idealists. Only the beating heart of Russia sustains its pace in the silence.
strings.NOV_order_and_stability_desc:
While expanding outwards and reclaiming those parts of Russia under opposing governments is well and good, if we do not work to maintain order within liberated areas and secure them under our control, the ensuing disorder and unrest may very well harm production, or worse, lead to an end of our grip in outlying regions.

An increased garrison and bolstered police presence would do wonders for the power we wield in the areas we take from other governments in Russia, as well as ensure that nobody dares to oppose our plans, regardless of ideology. The sooner order and stability are returned throughout land under our rule, whether recently acquired or a loyal part of our state, the sooner our good and steady governance can be used to make our principles a reality.
strings.NOV_temporary_military_governors_desc:
Unfortunately, we can't trust newly liberated territories to not fall right back into extremism if given the opportunity through a civilian government. As such, we will pass a new law to place any and all new lands under a temporary military administration to maintain order and eradicate extremist ideals before true integration into the Federation.

The military governors will be given absolute authority to deal with any suspected treasonous activities, barring direct orders from the government in Novosibirsk against specific actions. Although this will last only as long as absolutely necessary, this is unlikely to be popular among the people of such territories, so we must warn the military governors to avoid upsetting them further if possible.
strings.NOV_the_industrial_preservation_act_desc:
Industry is a critical part of waging any war, for the factories keep the men armed and unarmed men don't wage war very well. However, at the current rate our industrial base will be unable to keep up with our expansion, and thinning supply lines might mean more death or even defeat for our armies.

As such, the Industrial Preservation Act has been proposed, to keep the maintenance of our current factories going and increase the speed with which new factories are constructed. This act will allow us to industrialize further and therefore maintain the current rate of reunification of Russia, and there is little doubt that the faster Russia is reunified, the better.
strings.NOV_maintain_the_trans_siberian_railway_:
The Trans-Siberian Railway serves as an artery of the region, a vital connection between the most critical cities and towns to the continued operation of our government. Letting it fall into disrepair would more than simply be a mistake, as it could be fatal to our plans, with the ease of transport for our soldiers and support for our supply lines vanishing if it falls too deeply into disrepair.

What's more, much of the economy, both local and national, is dependent on the continued success of the railway. We must immediately set about repairing those parts of it in need of it and restoring it to peak condition, as well as maintaining it well in the future to ensure it does not fall into a similar situation.
strings.NOV_stamping_out_the_embers_desc:
There exists, in the heart of every Siberian, the flame of rebellion and idealism. Bukharin, for all his failures as the leader of the Soviet Union, has become the Siberian Prometheus. Arising from the ashes of the communist state are thinkers versed in ideological debate and discipline, incitors of ideals and violence, carriers of fire and innovation. The Central Siberian Republic, the culmination of this blazing passion, shattered as soon as the wind blew against the course of their destination.

From our sanctuary in the heart of Siberia, the Federation marched out, triumphing over the remnants of the Central Siberian Republic. For here, we shall say: no, to the brutality of idealism. No, to the senseless waste of ideology. No, to the unbridled rage of humane passion. No, we say, to the fire that has burnt around us, within us, as the soles of our boots fall upon the last streaks of ember. The days past and future are gone. There exists only the present.
strings.NOV_a_sovereign_heartland_desc:
Silence reigns where the noise and din of the marketplace once ruled. Where merchants from faraway lands come to haggle their goods in the bazaars of thought that were once the Central Siberian Republic, now their stalls lay upturned on the gravel streets, their contents gathered at the pyre, waiting for the single match stroke. The Narodniks, Communists, Anarchists, Idealists, Rurikids - all are priests of false gods masquerading as an intent of human innovation and improvement. Nothing they offer could enlighten a person to his sovereignty. The noise and din offer nothing but flirtations with the meaningless.

The Federation has embraced the silence. Where ideals had once been worshipped, we have dragged the idols of these ersatz divinities and cast them out. There is nothing noble in idealism. The act of believing in a higher ideal does not render one a paragon. The brutality of ideologies is over, and sovereignty reigns alone, supreme.
strings.NOV_the_victorious_federation_desc:
At last, Central Siberia has been united under our authority, with our rivals in the region vanquished and their loyalists scattered, forced into hiding or exile. However, for the continued success of our Federation, much work remains to be done.

First there is the matter of consolidating our gains, by integrating the new territories more closely and securing our boundaries. Then we must consider how to stabilize our rule and satisfying the people, in hopes of restoring the law, order, and stability that is so desperately needed. Many problems remain, but beyond them lies a bright future for the Federation.
strings.NOV_bread_and_games_desc:
Above all else, everyday people desire just two things: bread to feed themselves with, and games with which to entertain them. So long as these are provided and made easily accessible, there will be little cause for unhappiness and unrest among the people, and therefore very little room for extremist organizations to grow and gain strength.

While some sacrifices must be made to achieve this, they are more than worth the current and future stability of our state.
strings.NOV_appoint_new_governors_desc:
Although the practice of appointing military governors of freshly conquered territories has served us very well, it was always intended to be a temporary measure due to the fragile nature of the situation we were in.

Now that we are in a more secure position, it is finally time to make good on our promise to remove them, and appoint new ones in their place to aid the integration into the Federation of new lands, as well as the restoration of stability and reduction of popular unrest.
strings.NOV_enshrine_the_silovik_state_desc:
We must push forward with the idea of a state built on the principles of national stabilization and strength above all else, and managed by military officers who have proven their competence.

Effective and capable men are necessary to unite all of Russia under the Federation, and the past failure of states such as the Central Siberian Republic, which thought of stability and security as secondary concerns, has only proven further the necessity of this structure for the sake of peace.
strings.NOV_reward_our_allies_desc:
Promises are promises, and we made quite a few of them to our corporate friends during our time of crisis. Now that we are in less immediate danger, they expect these promises to be kept, and our government has always at least met expectations.

We shall grant them new and more generous contracts with the Federation, to allow them to expand into and exploit the resources of the new territories under our control. This will make their past investments into our cause profitable and convince them that continued cooperation with us would be in their best interest.
strings.NOV_trust_in_the_party_of_power: Trust in the Party of Power
strings.NOV_trust_in_the_party_of_power_desc:
What is needed above all else by the people is prosperity for them and stability of the state, and we cannot rely on popular will to bring this about. Democracy has failed us in the past, and giving it another chance would be a serious, and possibly fatal, mistake.

Instead, our objective should be solidifying our control over the state apparatus and levers of power, in order to centralize the powers of the government and give the people what they should have, even if it is not what they want.
strings.NOV_a_nod_to_democracy_desc:
Though it might seem unwise to rely once more on a system that failed us all miserably, there is an argument to be made for allowing the masses a greater measure of democracy, mainly that it would serve to placate those hesitant to accept our government.

This would take the form of minor concessions and reforms within the state, as well as opening more leadership positions to civilians and supporters of democratic power. Of course, we would not go so far as to allow the people to have real power over us, but by appearing to scale back our control over them, they might be more eager to serve our purposes.
strings.NOV_a_controlled_political_spectrum_desc:
Although they have little actual chance of taking power again, it's always wisest not to underestimate the ambitions of the extreme movements of the left and right.

In order to weaken them, and therefore strengthen our government, we will play them against each other, distracting them with their petty ideological struggle while convincing the people of their dangerous and violent nature, thereby slowly reducing them to irrelevancy without us having to act openly against them. By doing so, we will take control of all politics in the Federation, and keep the demagogues in check.
strings.NOV_consider_barnauls_position_desc:
Novosibirsk may be the administrative center of the Federation, but the adjacent city of Barnaul is also an important lynchpin in our nation. Its mayor, Vasily Shukshin, has quickly grown to be the second most powerful politician within the halls of power, and his particular views on how the state should be run have become more prominent as well.

Unfortunately, Shukshin's rise has caused some rather predictable tension with his main rival: President Pokryshkin. In order to put a stop to this bickering before it gets out of control, perhaps it would be prudent to reach out to Shukshin and see if he's willing to compromise in some way.
strings.NOV_the_vestiges_of_revolt_desc:
The scars of the Workers' Revolt still remain, and if nothing is done soon they will continue to fester unabated. We must remind the working class of Siberia that no matter what their grievances may be with our administration, rebellion will not be tolerated.

In addition to repairing the damage still left over from the fighting, we will restore order to the industrial sectors of the region and let any potential dissenters know that we are still in charge. Several methods have been proposed, and it will ultimately be up to our wise and noble President to decide which would be the best course of action.
strings.NOV_the_sovereign_security_act_desc:
No preventative measures are too drastic when the safety of our people is on the line! Terrorists and would-be revolutionaries lurk behind every corner, and our current means of dealing with them simply is not sufficient any longer. A stronger, more iron-fisted approach is necessary.

The Sovereign Security Act will be our savior in these dark times. Our counter-insurgency forces will enjoy increased funding and supplies to perform their duties with enhanced efficiency, while certain political liberties abused by our hidden foes will be cracked down on. This is not likely to be a popular act with our people, but hopefully they will realize the necessity of such measures when our streets are safe again.
strings.NOV_sensible_concessions_desc:
Some would suggest that an iron-clad hand is necessary to prevent unrest amongst the labor, but they fail to realize that such methods would only inflame working man's anger even more. The last thing we need right now is to pour gasoline on the embers of the last disaster, so perhaps a different approach is needed.

We shall reach out to prominent union leaders and labor activists to work out some sort of arrangement that would be best for both parties. If successful, we will kill two birds with one stone: our workers will have no reason to revolt against us, and our industry can finally achieve its past glories. All that remains now is to make the arrangements.
strings.NOV_maintaining_the_equilibrium_desc:
For the first time in many months, our cities are finally returning to their pre-revolt orderliness, but there is still work to be done. Old ghosts from the unification wars still haunt our new territories to this very day, and they will need to be excorcized if our Federation wishes to move forward into a bold new future.

A heightened police presence will dissuade our new subjects from any foolish action, but a strong show of force is only half the battle. Meetings will be held with the provincial governors and mayors across Siberia to discuss the best way to finish the integration of these troubled lands. With luck, we won't have to give too many concessions in the name of stability.
strings.NOV_active_measures_desc:
There are many ways one can influence the course of history to their liking. Some of these methods may appear small, but make big changes in the grand scheme of things. After all, if a ship changes its course only slightly, the destination shall be entirely different. In this instance, our destination is a strong and stable Russia.

Our security forces are no stranger to manipulating the chain of events to suit our purposes. A few dishonest media campaigns here, a counterfeit document or two there... all our agents must do is pull a few hidden strings, and the minds of our people will be forever focused in a more suitable direction. After all, an ignorant citizen is a content citizen...
strings.NOV_special_administrative_zones_desc:
Our foes during the unification wars were a diverse bunch, if nothing else. From the mad monarchists of Kemerovo to the armchair philosophers and artists of Tomsk; they all had vastly different approaches to governing their lands, and bafflingly enough? Most of them worked.

Why change what is already working? As long as these regions remain loyal to us, there is no need to crack down on them. “Special Administrative Zones” have been established in these formerly hostile territories to continue the administrative methods of their previous owners, while still bringing them in line with our own ideals of governance. Any regions whose administration cannot be adapted, however, can always be granted to our friends in the industrial sector...
strings.NOV_all_things_in_union_desc:
The challenge may have seemed insurmountable at first, but at last we can say that our administrative troubles are over. The last wounds of the Workers' Revolt have finally healed, while our new lands continue to adapt well to the Federation's laws.

More importantly, however, it seems our political disagreements with Barnaul have also been mended, at least for the time being. At last, President Pokryshkin is finally free to shape Siberia however he sees fit. With all the moving parts of our nation working in harmonious unison once again, our Federation will be reforged into a nation of iron; worthy of claiming the mantle of the legitimate Russian government!
strings.NOV_the_siberian_economy_desc:
Our consolidation of Central Siberia has opened up to us the vast wealth and potential that lies within Siberia. Siberia contains the potential to become the foundation of a strong Russian state, one that will extend its might from the Pacific to Moscow.

In order to properly realise Siberia's potential we must leverage our already impressive industrial base to exploit the wealth of the region. With the help of the National Champions, our economic growth will be truly frightening to behold.
strings.NOV_establish_educational_standards_desc:
How can we hope to cultivate a world-class economy when our people continue to go about their lives without an education to speak of? To say that our education system is in shambles would allude to the existence of such a system to begin with. In reality, any semblance of a proper schooling body fell into the abyss along with the rest of the Soviet Union over two decades ago.

Let us finally lay out the groundwork for a proper education system. We shall develop new curricula and guidelines for the classrooms, to make sure that the students of the Federation are being taught in the ways of the modern world.
strings.NOV_grants_for_research_and_development_:
We're never going to be able to stay ahead of our rivals when the entire Federation still uses technological methods that wouldn't look out of date thirty years ago. Unfortunately, having an advanced society is a bit more complicated than just waiting for skilled scientists and technicians to appear.

To speed the process along, we shall strategically designate certain sectors within the nation to receive specialized grants to aid research and development. Once we grease the wheels a little, the next generation of scientists will be within our reach.
strings.NOV_repurpose_the_siberian_plan_desc:
Up until now, the Federation's industrial might has been built on the back of Bukharin's Siberian Plan. While the Siberian Plan was by far Bukharin's greatest achievement, it cannot be denied that the industrial base it was responsible for has been lagging behind in the march of progress.

We should use the plan as a template with which to create a modern and improved plan in order to meet the needs of a modern industrial state. It will be up to the industrial theorists and brilliant minds of the Federation to build this new plan, but when it is complete our industrial might will be unassailable within Russia.
strings.NOV_promote_the_national_champions_desc:
The corporations of Feniks, Sibir, and Titan are the engines that keep the Siberian Federation rolling. Without their considerable economic power at our side, it is likely that we wouldn't have been able to come as far as we have. They provide boundless employment opportunities, unmatched industrial expertise, and most importantly economic growth beyond our wildest dreams.

Our national champions deserve a central role in the economy. This has been the case all along, of course, but it is time to make this arrangement official. The Federation shall march forward with its loyal corporations as its greatest weapon!
strings.NOV_expand_the_factory_city_desc:
Novosibirsk is widely known as a “factory city”; an industrial lynchpin that is sometimes regarded as more of a giant factory than a place where people make their homes. Indeed, this city is the most industrialized in all of Siberia, and we see no reason why we shouldn't embrace this fact.

With the help of our loyal “national champions”, Novosibirsk shall be expanded far beyond its current, already extensive capabilities. This city shall be one that never rests; where the factories stretch beyond that which the eye can see, and work day and night to build a stronger, safer future for all of us.
strings.NOV_consolidate_the_energy_sector_desc:
Under the soil of Siberia lie vast reserves of oil and natural gas, fuel hydrocarbons, the lifeblood of the modern age. Until now, those riches lay mostly unexplored, but that must end very soon. We must organize and consolidate the energy extraction industry.

No longer to be left in the hands of small companies and adventurers, the nature of this business demands intense capital, and our government will grant that. With the guarantee of profit to our private partners and investors by way of an established monopoly and government inputs, the Siberian energy sector will be genuinely efficient.
strings.NOV_the_riches_of_siberia2_desc:
As we continue to expand our industrial base it will be imperative to keep up a constant flow of resources to feed the engines of progress. Thankfully, the lands of Siberia are rich with the natural resources that will be essential to driving our ever growing economic needs.

With the aid of our good friends and allies in the National Champions it is only a matter of time before the vast wealth of Siberia will be available to us in quantities unheard of before.

The riches of Siberia must be exploited for the good of the Federation.
strings.NOV_supervise_the_agricultural_sector_de:
The lands of the Altay near Novosibirsk are incredibly fertile, being almost without compare in the region and a potentially invaluable asset to our plans.

However, attempts to make use of this natural bounty are impeded by the great disarray and inefficiency present in our agricultural sector, a problem that we are increasingly forced to give our attention to prevent it from worsening.

Fortunately for us, there is a simple solution to this, which is establishing firm and vigilant supervision of the whole sector, allowing us to streamline and organize it.
strings.NOV_subsidies_for_mechanization_desc:
